input.quote: Customer shall be responsible and solely liable for all the Content (including without limitation all intellectual property rights therein) and the Properties.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no intellectual property or ownership provision. Section 6(a) allocates liability for the Content and Properties to Customer but does not confirm Customer's ownership; Section 9(c)(i) is only a warranty that Customer owns the Content; Section 14(b) covers names, trademarks and logos only. Nothing addresses ownership of the "Requests" data sent by Customer to Kubient, visitor/audience data collected via the Auction Platform, or any deliverables, reports or work product created for Customer, and there is no licence-back of Kubient IP embedded in deliverables. For AP, whose content and audience data are its core assets, silence leaves ownership of the data flowing to Kubient and of any Kubient-created work product unresolved. There is no assignment of Customer IP to Kubient (so no walk-away trigger), but the rule expects an ownership clause and no usable clause exists, so we have added one at the preferred position: AP retains all rights in Content, Properties and Customer Data; Kubient assigns deliverables while retaining its pre-existing platform and technology subject to a perpetual, royalty-free licence for embedded IP; no joint ownership.

proposal.summary: Add ownership clause: AP retains all rights in Content, Properties and data; Kubient assigns deliverables and licenses embedded Kubient IP; no joint ownership.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement is silent on intellectual property, so we have added an ownership provision confirming that we retain all right, title and interest in our Content, Properties and data and that any deliverables created for us are assigned to us, with Kubient retaining its pre-existing platform and technology subject to a perpetual, royalty-free licence for anything embedded in deliverables. Our playbook requires that we own what we pay for and what we put in, with no joint ownership and no transfer of our data or IP to a vendor.

ops.text: (b) Ownership of Content, Data and Deliverables. As between the Parties, Customer exclusively owns and retains all right, title and interest, including all intellectual property rights, in and to the Content, the Properties, the Inventory, the Requests and all other data, information and materials provided or made available by Customer or collected from the Properties by or on behalf of Kubient (collectively, "Customer Data"). Kubient hereby assigns to Customer all right, title and interest in and to any deliverables, reports, work product and other materials created by or for Kubient specifically for Customer under this Agreement, excluding Kubient's pre-existing or generally applicable technology, tools and know-how (including the Auction Platform), which Kubient retains and hereby licenses to Customer on a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free basis to the extent embedded in or necessary to use such deliverables. Kubient's rights in Customer Data are limited to a non-exclusive right to use Customer Data solely as necessary to provide the Services during the Term, and nothing in this Agreement creates any ownership or joint ownership in Kubient of the Content, the Properties, Customer Data or any deliverables.
